description: Email a customer a password reset link, the same one the site's forgot-password flow sends; it works for one hour. For an active customer who cannot sign in. Refused for a suspended customer, for one who has not verified yet (use resend_customer_verification), for a customer whose account model has no password sign-in, when the workspace has no public site URL to link to, and after five account emails to the same customer in an hour. `emailSent: false` means the link was issued but the mailer did not take the email. Only call after the user confirms.
name: send_customer_password_reset
